tonal_mismatches.line_excerpt: He turned straight to Thomas: "Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands;
tonal_mismatches.rationale: The single tag spans the whole quote, but the line moves from a gentle opening invitation ('Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands') to a firm closing charge ('be not faithless, but believing') — [deliberate] alone risks flattening that shift into one even register; adding [emphasized] gives the closing charge its own weight.

concerns: The opening line's quote ('We have seen the Lord') is correctly left unattributed since it belongs to a collective group ('ten men') not in the roster — confirmed intentional, not an oversight.

Beat 3 ('Eight days he stayed with them anyway') is tagged [reflective]; [matter-of-fact] would also be defensible for this more expository bridging line — not a real mismatch, just noting the alternative reading.
